model_meta.system_name: Hydraulic spool valve with pressure-loaded actuator plate
model_meta.description: Conceptual model of the claimed hydraulic spool valve arrangement that routes hydraulic fluid and uses pressure acting on a movable plate to maintain drive-lever contact.

subsystems.description: Spool assembly with pressure and return chambers, actuator slot, and fluid path from pressure chamber to slot; a movable pressure plate lies between the path and drive lever. Optional cavity, restrictor, and guides are optional disclosed features, not assumed present.
functional_basis: press drive lever against slot wall

subsystems.description: Housing receives the spool; fluid connections connect its pressure chamber and at least one return chamber to a pump, hydraulic cylinder, and reservoir. Individual cylinder-side connection mapping is not specified.
External hydraulic supply entity providing pressurized fluid to the valve.
External hydraulic load connected to pressure and return chambers.
External fluid sink/source for the valve's return connection.
External mechanical input received in the spool actuator slot; the pressure plate maintains contact with the lever.

item_flows.name: Pressurized hydraulic fluid
item_flows.notes: Pressurized supply fluid connected to the spool pressure chamber; exact housing and cylinder endpoint allocation is not specified.

item_flows.name: Cylinder hydraulic flow
item_flows.notes: Fluid routed between pressure chamber and hydraulic cylinder depending on spool position.

item_flows.name: Return hydraulic fluid
item_flows.notes: Return-chamber route from the hydraulic cylinder toward the reservoir; separate from actuator-slot drainage into the return chamber.

item_flows.name: Drive lever motion and contact force
item_flows.notes: Lever received in slot; plate presses lever against opposite slot wall.

item_flows.name: Pressure-chamber fluid to actuator slot
item_flows.notes: Internal fluid path from pressure chamber into actuator slot; fluid entering the slot drains to the return chamber. No separate external slot-drain connection is asserted.

requirements.statement: The spool fluid path shall connect the pressure chamber to the actuator slot, with the movable pressure plate between the fluid path and the drive lever.
The pressure plate shall maintain contact with the drive lever; in the cavity embodiment, fluid pressure is sufficient to press the lever against the opposite slot wall.
requirements.rationale: Claims 1 and 9; no quantitative pressure or force value is specified.

requirements.statement: Fluid entering the actuator slot through the fluid path drains to the return chamber.
requirements.rationale: Claim 2; claim 3 states no seals are provided between the actuator slot and return chamber.

actions.name: Apply hydraulic preload to drive lever

steps.description: Pressure-chamber fluid enters the fluid path connecting the chamber to the actuator slot.
Fluid pressure acts on the movable pressure plate positioned between the fluid path and drive lever.
The plate maintains contact with the drive lever and presses it against the opposite slot wall.
Fluid passing into the actuator slot drains to the return chamber.
